name: Granite Shortstick
description: Hold the baton upright by the shoulder with the point low, so any attack meets the shaft before the body.

name: Scorching Crackdown
description: Thrust the baton along the straight line to the opponent's solar plexus, wrist firm behind the tip.

name: Siltcuff
description: Step diagonally forward so the baton lands from the opponent's blind side.

name: Harrowing Switch
description: Rap the collarbone as the baton rebounds from a parry, using the rebound for speed.

name: Rapidrap Cuirass
description: Rap the baton onto the pulse point inside the wrist, a qi pulse numbing the hand for a breath.

name: Hoarfrost Gripwrap
description: Hook the baton behind the leading knee and pull with qi, dropping the opponent to one knee.

name: Lot Weightend
description: Drive the baton onto the nerve at the elbow so that qi in the arm is held shut for several breaths.

name: Funneling Lanyardloop
description: Chain a sealing rap on the wrist directly into a collarbone cut, the second blow landing on the numbed arm.

name: Facet Balanceknob
description: Rest the rod's tip lightly against the opponent's guard and feel which foot carries their weight.

name: Iron Capend
description: Prod the rod's tip at the front thigh to see whether the opponent's weight shifts to meet it.

name: Might Cuff
description: Sway away from a committed lean and step to where the opponent's weight is heading.

name: Equipoise Batongrip
description: Slap the flat of the rod against a punch's wrist to turn the arm away.

name: Gust Tick
description: Tap the rod against the heel of the weighted foot to unsettle the stance.

name: Mayhem Stun
description: Hook the rod behind the ankle just as the opponent lifts the foot, tripping them with a small pulse of qi.

name: Dominating Truncheon
description: As the opponent's weight transfers, pin the elbow to their ribs with the rod and hold it with steady qi.

name: Suppressing Hardwood
description: Catch the opponent's lead arm over the rod and pull the weight forward past the toes.

name: Tickassault
description: Strike the shoulder joint at the instant the opponent's weight is committed forward, so that their own momentum adds to the blow.

name: Gyve Sidebar
description: Slide the rod under the lunging arm and use the opponent's own weight to bear them to the floor, held there by qi pressure.

name: Hoarfrost Lanyardloop
description: Stand with the baton before the chest and let a thin field of qi lie along its length.

name: Tempered Tick
description: Thrust the baton with a lunge that adds a full pace to its reach.

name: Batoncanter
description: Glide into range with the field trailing the baton so the opponent sees only its tip.

name: Steadfast Balanceknob
description: Meet a blow at the edge of the field with the baton's side, turning it before it reaches the hand.

name: Rumble Shortstick
description: Shove the baton forward and let the qi field along the shaft push the opponent back a step.

name: Ponderous Weightend
description: Hook the baton's end round the opponent's arm and draw it with the field, tugging them out of balance.

name: Shadeswitch
description: Lay the baton across the chest and press, the field spreading the pressure so that breathing tightens.

name: Fastening Switch
description: Extend the field a pace past the tip and close it round the opponent's wrist, holding the arm from a distance.

name: Spikecuff
description: Drive the baton's field through a raised guard so that its force lands on the body behind the arms.

name: Hardwood Plating
description: Let qi stand round the body as a living field and keep the baton drawn back at the hip inside it.

name: Rumblecuff
description: Cut across the opponent's guard in a long stride, the baton arriving as the rear foot passes.

name: Silt Capend
description: Pivot on the lead foot inside the field and square the shoulders to a new line.

name: Hardened Sidebar
description: Let a stroke slide down the shaft and off the guard, then step in behind it.

name: Might Batongrip
description: Chop the baton down onto the thick muscle between neck and shoulder, short and sharp.

name: Murk Truncheon
description: Raise the baton wide and high to catch a downward swing on the shaft's middle.

name: Suppressing Stun
description: Press the baton against the thigh and anchor the leg with the field so the opponent cannot step.

name: Subduing Rapidrap
description: Wind a band of qi round the opponent's forearm with the baton and draw it tight like a cord.

name: Crippling Crackdown
description: Meet an arriving blow with a sudden surge down the shaft that jolts the attacker's arm and spoils the follow-up.

name: Chimestun
description: Hook the baton behind the opponent's knee and sweep, adding a hip turn that throws them onto their back.

name: Deed Switch
description: Close the field round the opponent's arm along the baton, clamping the limb and sealing its qi for as long as the hold lasts.

name: Doctrine Balanceknob
description: Finish the treatise with one run of raps to wrist, elbow and shoulder, each blow riding on the last.

name: Staunch Gripwrap
description: Hold the baton in the strike hand while the guard hand floats open before the chest, each ready to swap roles.

name: Lanyardloop Jaunt
description: Advance with feet and hands in matching pairs, lead foot with lead hand, rear with rear.

name: Stunbarrage
description: Rap the opponent's left forearm and then the right, the baton passing between hands in between.

name: Batonplating
description: Pass the baton to the guard hand mid-parry, so the original striking hand is free to answer.

name: Gyvebaton
description: Swap hands on the baton while hooking the opponent's arm, so that the pull never pauses.

name: Mayhembaton
description: Drive the baton into the wrist along the strike track while the guard hand clamps the forearm, jamming the hand open.

name: Stifling Hardwood
description: Press the baton and the guard hand together on one joint, holding it with two lines of qi.

name: Suppressing Lot Sidebar
description: Reverse the roles of the hands mid-strike and land the seal on the nerve the opponent had covered.

name: Intent Cuff
description: Alternate guard and strike tracks in a cascade of four short blows, each hand taking the baton in turn.

name: Iron Batongrip
description: Perch in a high guard with the baton raised like a folded wing, qi gathered at the shoulders.

name: Granite Rapidrap
description: Curve forward in a bending step like a river round a stone, ending beside the opponent's guard.

name: Rumblebilly
description: Drop from the high guard in a swift stoop and rap the opponent's crown guard hand.

name: Chimebaton
description: Hold the baton in a rounded arc like a basin's rim, so that blows slide off its curve.

name: Silt Crackdown
description: Bend with an attack like a reed in a stream and come upright behind it.

name: Batonbarrage
description: Jab the baton's tip at the soft part of the upper arm like a talon striking.

name: Ponderous Truncheon
description: Hook the baton behind the arm and pull in a steady stream, the opponent flowing along with it.

name: Mayhemcapend
description: Turn the baton in a small eddy against the opponent's wrist, spinning the hand away from its grip.

name: Shade Tick
description: Clamp the wrist between baton and fingers like a hawk's grip and hold it with a steady pulse of qi.

name: Lambasting Shortstick
description: Curve the baton round the guard like a river round a bend and strike through the gap, qi passing through the arm.

name: Charter Weightend
description: Stoop on the wrist from the high guard and seal the qi at the joint, locking the hand open.

name: Billycuirass
description: Hold the baton at the centre with qi in both lines of the arm, ready to push along either.

name: Lancing Gripwrap
description: Rap the outer edge of the opponent's forearm, the blow bright and clean.

name: Might Capend
description: Glide two feet in a paired slip to the opponent's outside, the baton angled in.

name: Equipoise Shortstick
description: Cover both lanes of the body with one sweep, one end of the baton high and the other low.

name: Rumble Stun
description: Tap the shaft against the opponent's forearm so qi hums through the wood and numbs the skin.

name: Ponderous Gripwrap
description: Hook the baton on the left line of the opponent's arm and draw it across their body.

name: Intenttick
description: Press the baton down the right line of the shoulder and hold the weight there with qi.

name: Switch Plating
description: Send two small surges of qi down the baton to jam both the wrist and elbow joints at once.

name: Lancebaton
description: Carry two lines of qi down the shaft so that the blow lands once and then again an instant after.

name: Doctrine Hardwood
description: Seal the wrist, then seal the elbow with the next beat, so the arm closes down joint by joint.

name: Granite Sidebar
description: Take a bearing on the opponent's chest and hold the baton on that line, the stance steady against any gust.

name: Vaulting Tick
description: Step with the broad low stance of the plateau, feet wide, knees soft, never crossing the line.

name: Tempered Weightend
description: Rap the opponent's windward arm, the one nearest the bearing, before the wind turns.

name: Lanyardloop Plating
description: Cut across the line of attack like a crosswind and send the blow past the shoulder.

name: Gyve Batongrip
description: Hook the baton behind the arm on the held bearing and pull the opponent onto that line.

name: Mayhem Balanceknob
description: Tap the baton like a gust on a joint, a short surge of qi making it give.

name: Stifling Capend
description: Rap the nerve on the opponent's windward arm so that qi in the limb is held shut.

name: Intent Crackdown
description: Run three raps down one held bearing, wrist then elbow then shoulder, ending with the baton still on the line.

name: Resilient Lanyardloop
description: Hold the rod low and open-handed as a sign that the first purpose is to restrain.

name: Batonsprint
description: Step to the very edge of the opponent's reach and stay there, the weight kept low and ready.

name: Cuffbarrage
description: Rap the weapon hand's wrist so the weapon drops, striking nothing else.

name: Unyielding Truncheon
description: Drop the rod low and sweep it up to stop a kick or a low swing.

name: Gust Batongrip
description: Hold the breath and jab the rod into the muscle under the ribs, then let go of the breath.

name: Gust Sidebar
description: Slip to the side like a gust round a post, the rod trailing behind.

name: Cuffcloak
description: Hook the rod behind the arm and hold it there, keeping the grip gentle but unbroken.

name: Mayhemtick
description: Shove the opponent toward the edge of their own balance with the rod's middle and a flush of qi.

name: Crippling Cuff
description: Lay the rod over the arm and pin it light as wind but firm, a steady qi pressure keeping it down.

name: Toxin Gripwrap
description: Tap the pulse point at the wrist with a qi pulse timed to the opponent's heartbeat.

name: Scalding Granite Cuff
description: Strike the large thigh muscle to drop the opponent, then pause with the rod raised, holding the blow to what restraint needs.

name: Intent Stun
description: Close the rod along the whole arm and seal its qi with a held, even pressure until the oath is kept.

name: Billycloak
description: Stand in the open with the baton level and the qi field spreading out round the body, no wall at the back.

name: Truncheon Sprint
description: Step along the wind's edge, never straight into it, so the baton arrives from the flank.

name: Might Hardwood
description: Rap the arm and step on without stopping, since in open ground there is no wall to pin against.

name: Hardened Weightend
description: Parry without letting the baton leave its bearing, so that the guard and the line stay the same.

name: Ravaging Switch
description: Chop with a long gust of the body behind the baton, the whole stance moving through the blow.

name: Rumble Tick
description: Jab with the baton while the qi field extends a hand's breadth past the tip.

name: Fastening Shortstick
description: Hook the baton behind the arm and pull in one long gale-like draw that carries the opponent off their feet.

name: Toxin Stun
description: Jam the open guard hand against the baton and shove the opponent's wrist aside in one surge.

name: Shadebilly
description: Let the qi field lean on the opponent like a steady wind and press them down with the baton's weight.

name: Cuff Hauberk
description: Strike through the field at the nerve of the elbow from a pace away, sealing the arm's qi.

name: Cuffthrash
description: Hold the bearing and drive the baton's field straight through the raised guard into the chest behind it.
